description: 9-day annual mega festival celebrated with grand vahanas and daily processions around the four Mada streets. In Adhika Masa years, two Brahmotsavams are conducted.
importance: The grandest annual festival established by Lord Brahma himself, attracting hundreds of thousands of pilgrims.

schedule.events: Mohini Avataram & Srivari Garuda Seva (07:00 PM – Midnight with 300,000+ devotees)
Hanumantha Vahanam, Swarna Ratham (Golden Chariot) & Gaja Vahanam
Rathotsavam (Maha Theru Wooden Chariot) & Ashwa Vahanam

description: Opening of the sacred inner Vaikuntha Dwaram circumambulating the sanctum sanctorum for 10 consecutive days.
importance: Passing through the golden Vaikuntha Dwaram during these 10 days is believed to bestow moksha (liberation).

description: One-day mega event where Lord Malayappa Swamy rides 7 different vahanas from 05:30 AM to 09:00 PM.
importance: Honors the Sun God with non-stop vahana processions starting with Suryaprabha at dawn and concluding with Chandraprabha.

description: 5-day illuminated boat festival in the Swami Pushkarini holy tank during Phalguna Pournami.
importance: Processional deities glide across the holy tank on decorated floats (Day 1: Lord Rama; Day 2: Lord Krishna; Days 3–5: Sri Malayappa Swamy).

description: 3-day spring festival conducted at the Vasanta Mandapam starting on Trayodasi.
importance: Includes Snapana Tirumanjanam (sacred bath with milk, honey, coconut water, and turmeric) to give cooling relief to the deities.

description: 3-day annual festival celebrated in the evening at Narayanagiri Gardens.
importance: Re-enacts the celestial wedding of Lord Srinivasa and Goddess Padmavathi on Gaja, Ashwa, and Garuda vahanas.

description: 3-day ritual conducted during the Jyeshtha star constellation.
importance: Special Abhishekam and protective golden armor (Kavacham) installation to safeguard ancient Utsava Murthis from wear and tear.

description: Procession of the Lord on a palanquin beautifully decorated with tons of seasonal flowers.
importance: Marks the end of the traditional Tamil financial year and commencement of new accounting ledgers.

description: 3-day ritual starting on Ekadasi where holy silk threads (Pavithrams) are adorned on the deities.
importance: Purifies the temple and seeks forgiveness for any unwitting lapses or errors committed in daily rituals throughout the year.

description: Conducted after annual Brahmotsavams on the star Sravanam.
importance: Devotees and priests offer tons of fresh aromatic flowers to Sri Malayappa Swamy to ward off natural calamities.

month: 4 times a year (Precedes Ugadi, Anivara Asthanam, Brahmotsavam, and Vaikuntha Ekadasi)
description: Traditional cleansing of the inner sanctum (Garbha Griha), walls, ceiling, and idols with an aromatic herbal disinfectant paste (Kicchili Gadda, camphor, sandalwood, turmeric).
importance: Ensures complete spiritual and physical purification of the holy shrine before major festivals.

description: Special court assemblies (Asthanams) held inside Bangaru Vakili with traditional temple music and honors.
festivals_list: Adhyayanotsavam (25-day Tamil Prabandha recitation during Dhanurmasam)
